WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg_price, o.overall_avg_price
  FROM type_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE o.overall_avg_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ta.type_avg_price > o.overall_avg_price
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) AS mean_type_avg_price
  FROM above_overall
), remaining AS (
  SELECT ao.type_avg_price, ao.overall_avg_price, km.mean_type_avg_price
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
  WHERE km.mean_type_avg_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ao.type_avg_price > km.mean_type_avg_price
)
SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(type_avg_price - overall_avg_price) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(type_avg_price - mean_type_avg_price) AS average_above_kept_mean
FROM remaining;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is computed over all non-NULL unit_price values, and type averages are computed over non-NULL prices within each production_type_code. If no type remains after either threshold, the single result row contains NULL values.
